items.summary_en: A free 2-day live virtual trauma conference from Psychotherapy Networker (PESI) on 5-6 December 2026, 9:00am-4:00pm Central each day (23:00 Macau time to 06:00 the next day), led by Bessel van der Kolk, MD, with Licia Sky. Free registration includes 14-day access to the recording.

items.summary_en: A free 2-hour interactive webinar from Ohio State University College of Social Work (988 Lifeline Training Series) on 9 December 2026, 9:00-11:00am Eastern (22:00 Macau time on 9 December to 00:00 on 10 December), led by Dr. Brett J. Novick, LMFT. It covers PTSD in children across developmental stages, grief versus trauma, complex PTSD, CBT and other treatment modalities, and burnout in mental health providers. 2 CE clock hours approved for Ohio counselors, marriage and family therapists and social workers.
